exposure: Leiomyomata classified by FIGO Types 2-6 up to 4 cm in diameter
Uterine cavity up to 12 cm in length
outcome: Quality of life (using the Menorrhagia Impact Questionnaire)
Medical or surgical reintervention for abnormal uterine bleeding
cohort: 155 premenopausal women aged 30 to 50 years with heavy menstrual bleeding (HMB) secondary to Abnormal Uterine Bleeding due to Endometrial disorders or Leiomyomata (AUB-E and AUB-L).
finding: Water vapor endometrial ablation for heavy menstrual bleeding (HMB) demonstrated consistent positive outcomes at 36 months, including a high rate of amenorrhea or light menstrual flow (72%), improved quality of life, high patient satisfaction (93%), and a low re-intervention rate (7.1%).
